authoringNotes: Scenario primitives: E1-E4 are founders (T2 inside bootstrap window per v0.1.3 §3); A1-A7 are the injected arbiter set per proposal (arbiter-draw-v1 is deterministic but vector scenarios inject the draw result to stay independent of reputation history; the engine's real draw is exercised outside vectors). X is an unregistered applicant.
Heights are the only clock: blocksPerHour=6 (~10 min blocks), blocksPerDay=144; 6h war window = 36 blocks, 48h vote window = 288 blocks, 60min PoC window = 6 blocks.
ratePerSlugDaily default 10 and rateGlobalDaily 20 are scenario defaults (spec pins no initials); V17 overrides ratePerSlugDaily so only the global limit binds.
Reputation deltas (confirm-goodfaith +1 etc.) are engine constants pending reputation-algo-v1 pinning; V24 exercises direction only.
Event payloads here are minimal engine-facing shapes with synthetic ids; wire-level draft-07 validation against the 6-layer schema composite is G1's job (ajv) on tool-generated payloads.

Supplementary vectors S1-S12 are NOT part of the 25/25 pipeline: S1-S6 cover AC-C2 exemption boundaries and AC-D6 protected conjunction; S7-S12 lock the coverage gaps requested by the M1 report (C3 cluster merging via clusterAliases injection, C8 insufficient stake, C10 forged baselineRev, D2 PoC timeout, D4 self-appointment reverse cases, D5 bootstrap-window expiry + E-2 basic-right persistence).

E-2 conformance (pin://892ce8b2889cf20d2901dc955182b0674c5c7c85eccc055230bef205f377cca3i0): tier output is T0/T0+/T1/T2; T0 forbids revs (graveyard reason t0-no-rev), T0+ carries the basic edit right; V20/V21/S6/S12 assert the tier states.
determinismDeclarations: clusterAliases: production replay default = EMPTY set; alias tables are TEST-INJECTION ONLY (scenario-level option, same class as frozenArbiterOverrides). Production replay is a pure function of the pin stream — same stream, same view (loop ruling pin://63a2164522c53d6e81908865c3fdc4b6dcd58a9899e8bf42b3fa9d847b693846i0). An on-chain carrier for cluster tables is a v1.x open question (X11 forbids new MVP event types).
arbiterOverrides/frozenArbiterOverrides: same test-injection class; the engine real arbiter-draw-v1 path is exercised outside the vector scenarios.
E-3/E-2 semantics (refs = editor self-report, format-filter only, replay never queries an indexer; tier ladder T0/T0+/T1/T2) are engine-level conformance and are locked by the S6/S12 vectors.

competing branches, LWW keeps later; contest fact recorded per v0.1 §3.2.3 (correction 1)

regular revert produces equivalent rev (hash restored, reverter as author)
cross-entry revert is graveyards
revert with mismatched contentHash is graveyards
edit war: three weighted reverts reach threshold, freeze triggers (sole criterion)
two reverts stay under threshold, no freeze
write during freeze by non-arbiter is graveyards
arbiter-set member may write during freeze
challenge marks rev disputed, head unchanged
ruling dismiss with quorum clears disputed
ruling revert-to effective switches head to equivalent rev
V14-R: vote window expiry voids unfreeze proposal and auto-reverts baselineRev (neutral)
V15-R: approval-only counting; ineligible and reject votes never count
unregistered writer is graveyards
global daily rate limit: 21st rev of the day onward is graveyards
duplicate create becomes orphan (graveyard class)
redirect legal when target exists; missing target is graveyards
registration activates with PoC + stake + 4 endorsements in bootstrap window (correction 2); new editor sits in T0
register without enough endorsements never activates; premature rev is graveyards
mempool pin is excluded from replay until confirmed (two checkpoints)
post-void: immediate editing resumes and identical re-proposal is legal (no idempotency conflict)
arbiter snapshot at proposal: later reputation gain and outside-snapshot vote cannot save the tally; expiry voids and reverts
